Remarks

Provides access to the colliders, their velocities, collision points, and overlap information.

GetCollisionPointFacingTowardsSelf()

Finds the intersection point with the normal facing most in the direction of the Self colliders position. Each intersection point normal is checked against the direction from the intersection point towards the reference point.

Returns

IntersectionPoint

The IntersectionPoint facing most towards the 'self' collider's position, or a default IntersectionPoint if there are no collision points.
